fato_historico: 1942: World War II: The British passenger liner SS Tilawa is torpedoed and sunk by Japanese submarine I-29, with 280 passengers and crew killed out of 954 on board.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an urge to anchor yourself in stability, much like a steady ship navigating the tides of time. Just as resilience emerges from the deepest of challenges, you are encouraged to find beauty in your endurance. Perhaps it is a good time to nurture your spirit with small comforts and appreciate the grounding rhythm of your daily routine.
frase_do_dia: Strength blooms within the quiet heart that remains steady through the changing tides.
significado_numero: A powerful cycle signifying the strength found in overcoming past trials.
conselho: Consider taking a deep breath and focusing on the abundance already surrounding your path.
